def extract_features(signal):
    wavelet = "db4"
    levels = 5
    coeffs = pywt.wavedec(signal, wavelet, level=levels)
    w_features = []
    for coeff in coeffs:
        if len(coeff) < 2:
            continue
        w_features.extend(
            [
                np.sqrt(np.mean(coeff**2)),
                np.mean(np.abs(coeff - np.mean(coeff))),
                np.percentile(coeff, 75) - np.percentile(coeff, 25),
                np.std(coeff),
            ]
        )
    s_features = [
        np.mean(signal),
        np.std(signal),
        np.min(signal),
        np.max(signal),
        np.percentile(signal, 25),
        np.percentile(signal, 50),
        np.percentile(signal, 75),
        skew(signal),
        kurtosis(signal),
        np.mean(np.diff(signal)),
        (np.diff(signal) > 0).sum() / len(signal),
        (np.abs(signal) > np.std(signal)).mean(),
    ]
    return w_features + s_features


def process_segment(segment_path):
    df = pd.read_csv(segment_path).interpolate().ffill().bfill()
    features = []
    for sensor in df.columns:
        signal = df[sensor].values
        features += extract_features(signal)
    return np.array(features)

class VolcanicDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, file_paths, targets=None, mode="train"):
        self.file_paths = file_paths
        self.targets = targets
        self.mode = mode

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.file_paths)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        # Read and process data
        df = pd.read_csv(self.file_paths[idx]).fillna(0)
        data = df.values.astype(np.float32).T  # Shape: (10, 60000)

        # Downsample and normalize per sensor
        data = data[:, ::DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR]
        data = (data - data.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)) / (
            data.std(axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-8
        )

        if self.mode == "train":
            return torch.FloatTensor(data), torch.FloatTensor([self.targets[idx]])
        return torch.FloatTensor(data)


class TemporalCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.feature_extractor = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(10, 64, kernel_size=5, padding=2),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(4),
            nn.Conv1d(64, 128, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool1d(4),
            nn.Conv1d(128, 256, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool1d(1),
        )

        self.regressor = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256, 128), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3), nn.Linear(128, 1)
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        features = self.feature_extractor(x).squeeze(-1)
        return self.regressor(features)

                np.percentile(coeff, 75) - np.percentile(coeff, 25),

        np.percentile(signal, 75),
        skew(signal),
        kurtosis(signal),
        np.mean(np.diff(signal)),
        (np.diff(signal) > 0).sum() / len(signal),

    return w_features + s_features

    return [var0, mobility, complexity]

def spectral_entropy(signal):
    fft = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(signal))
    psd = fft**2
    psd_norm = psd / psd.sum()
    return entropy(psd_norm) if psd.sum() > 0 else 0


def zero_crossing_rate(signal):
    return ((signal[:-1] * signal[1:]) < 0).sum() / len(signal)


def rolling_features(signal, window=100):
    if len(signal) < window:
        return [0, 0]
    rolling_mean = np.mean(signal[-window:])
    rolling_std = np.std(signal[-window:])
    return [rolling_mean, rolling_std]


def hjorth_parameters(signal):
    first_deriv = np.diff(signal)
    second_deriv = np.diff(first_deriv)
    var0 = np.var(signal)
    var1 = np.var(first_deriv) if len(first_deriv) > 1 else 0
    var2 = np.var(second_deriv) if len(second_deriv) > 1 else 0
    mobility = np.sqrt(var1 / var0) if var0 != 0 else 0
    complexity = (np.sqrt(var2 / var1) / mobility) if var1 != 0 and mobility != 0 else 0
    return [var0, mobility, complexity]


def fft_features(signal):
    fft = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(signal))
    if len(fft) == 0:
        return [0] * 5
    return [
        np.mean(fft),
        np.std(fft),
        np.max(fft),
        np.percentile(fft, 25),
        np.percentile(fft, 75),
    ]


def extract_features(signal):
    # Enhanced wavelet decomposition
    coeffs_db8 = pywt.wavedec(signal, "db8", level=4)
    coeffs_sym5 = pywt.wavedec(signal, "sym5", level=3)
    w_features = []
    for coeff in coeffs_db8[:4]:
        w_features += [np.mean(coeff), np.std(coeff)]
    for coeff in coeffs_sym5[:3]:
        w_features += [np.mean(coeff), np.std(coeff)]

    # Temporal features
    s_features = [
        np.mean(signal),
        np.std(signal),
        skew(signal),
        kurtosis(signal),
        np.min(signal),
        np.max(signal),
        np.median(signal),
        np.percentile(signal, 25),
        np.percentile(signal, 75),
        zero_crossing_rate(signal),
        *rolling_features(signal, 100),
        *rolling_features(signal, 500),
    ]

    # Spectral features
    fft_feats = fft_features(signal)
    hjorth_feats = hjorth_parameters(signal)
    entropy_feat = spectral_entropy(signal)

def spectral_entropy(signal):
    fft = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(signal))
    psd = fft**2
    psd_norm = psd / psd.sum() if psd.sum() > 0 else np.zeros_like(psd)
    return entropy(psd_norm)


def zero_crossing_rate(signal):
    return ((signal[:-1] * signal[1:]) < 0).sum() / len(signal)


def rolling_features(signal, window=100):
    if len(signal) < window:
        return [0, 0]
    return [np.mean(signal[-window:]), np.std(signal[-window:])]


def hjorth_parameters(signal):
    first_deriv = np.diff(signal)
    var0 = np.var(signal)
    var1 = np.var(first_deriv) if len(first_deriv) > 1 else 0
    mobility = np.sqrt(var1 / var0) if var0 != 0 else 0
    second_deriv = np.diff(first_deriv)
    var2 = np.var(second_deriv) if len(second_deriv) > 1 else 0
    complexity = (np.sqrt(var2 / var1) / mobility) if var1 != 0 and mobility != 0 else 0
    return [var0, mobility, complexity]


def fft_features(signal):
    fft = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(signal))
    return [

        np.std(fft),
        np.max(fft),
        np.percentile(fft, 25),
        np.percentile(fft, 75),
    ]

        kurtosis(signal),
        np.min(signal),
        np.max(signal),
        np.median(signal),
        np.percentile(signal, 25),
        np.percentile(signal, 75),

        *rolling_features(signal, 500),
